args: Completed all three scenes. Gate and table combinations were readable and mildly satisfying, with the permission becoming a shared place at the table the strongest payoff. Stage two felt like matching abstract labels to a hidden sequence: welcome reading plus ordinary fast day and chapter 53 failed; brothers timetable plus fasting rule and host permission failed. Used two hints, which restored flow but supplied the recipe rather than helping me reason from source content. Blank source descriptions made those failures feel arbitrary. Continued because I wanted the hospitality question resolved; no urge to revisit or keep combining after the ending. Twenty attempts, sixteen accepted, twelve creations, four rejected combinations, two hints. Logical interface only; no claim about human enjoyment or visual usability.
